Context: 4. Option to avail benefits

- e. When discharged from service on invalidation or disability before completion of service of fifteen years or within three years of the notification of these rules without exercising an option, and is also not in a position to exercise an option at the time of discharge, he will be granted invalid pension or disability pension in accordance with the provisions of Pension Rules or Extraordinary Pension Rules, as the case may be, as default option.
